description:
Add order pack material. Add text or uploaded documents in materials to order_pack_id with request_id; returns the queued material publication and its target version. File preparation is free; new requests share a limit of three per email in 30 days and 20 starts per UTC day, with extras queued.
加材料（成员侧）。用 order_pack_id、materials 和 request_id 加入文字或已上传文件；返回材料版的排队状态及将出版的版号。文件免费；新单同邮箱30天最多开始3单，全站UTC日最多开始20单，超额排队。
name: add_order_pack_material
title: Add order pack material
